title: Israeli Airstrike on Mashghara Village (Bekaa Valley) Kills 12 in 'Ring of Fire'
detail: An Israeli airstrike struck the village of Mashghara in the West Bekaa district on May 26, killing at least 12 people. Lebanon's National News Agency reported eight consecutive strikes creating 'a ring of fire' around the town, with strikes targeting residential areas. The attack on Mashghara was one of the deadliest single-village incidents of the ongoing conflict and represented a significant expansion of Israeli strikes into the Bekaa Valley beyond southern Lebanon. Israel called up an additional battalion to Lebanon as operations intensified. The Lebanese Health Ministry and the Lebanese Red Cross responded to the scene; rescue teams faced challenges due to ongoing strikes in the area. The cumulative death toll for the day of May 26 reached at least 28–34 killed across Lebanon.

title: IDF Ground Forces Cross Litani River, Clash with Hezbollah at Zawtar al-Sharqiyah
detail: Israeli Defense Forces crossed the Litani River on May 26 to conduct raids targeting Hezbollah positions north of the traditional buffer zone — a significant escalation of the ground campaign. Israeli and Hezbollah forces clashed around Zawtar al-Sharqiyah on the northern bank of the Litani River. Hezbollah deployed rocket weapons, artillery, loitering drones, and direct point-blank engagement to repel the advance. By evening, the IDF had established a position on the outskirts of the village but had not secured it. The crossing of the Litani — historically the northern limit of Israeli ground operations — represented a major geographic expansion of the conflict and directly challenged the ceasefire framework's territorial basis. UN UNIFIL expressed 'deep alarm' at the IDF's advance north of the Litani.

media.caption: IDF crosses Litani River; Hezbollah engages at point-blank at Zawtar al-Sharqiyah — PBS NewsHour
